notes: Element X is the Matrix messenger on Google Play (io.element.android.x, 500k+ installs), designed against Element's Compound design system by an in-house design team. It has the largest preview corpus of anything surveyed: 494 preview-bearing files, of which 116 are in :libraries:designsystem alone — the buttons, dialogs, list items and avatars, each one screenshot-tested, which is what makes them self-contained enough to render outside the app. Ordinary Android Compose in src/main/kotlin, so the Robolectric lane. ref is develop, which is this project's default branch. previewAnnotations names PreviewsDayNight, the day/night multipreview the module's own previews carry: it is declared in this same module so the source pre-flight would probably see it, but naming it costs nothing and the failure it prevents ('matches no @Preview function in the scanned module') is opaque.
